_comments: The three settings the Lapsed Close Date Digest reads. All ship with an EMPTY Value, on purpose:
each is a host's own choice (its URL, its sender, its provider) and none has a default that is
right for every host. The rows exist so a host sees them in Application Settings and fills them
in. Each is read as blank-after-trim meaning unset. Primary keys are fixed so a host's edit
updates THIS row rather than creating a second one.

A metadata push or release upgrade does not overwrite a Value a host has filled in: the consolidated Metadata_Sync inserts rows only when absent. That is the current release pattern, not a guarantee for all time.

fields.Name: ExplorerBaseUrl
fields.Comments: The base URL of this host's MJ Explorer, for example https://explorer.example.com, used to turn each deal name in the digest into a link. Blank means deal names are rendered as plain text instead of links; nothing fails.

fields.Name: DigestFromAddress
fields.Comments: The fallback sender address for the digest, used for a recipient whose company has no CompanySenderIdentity. Blank means a send to such a recipient fails: the run records the error for that recipient and carries on with the others. The address must be one the configured provider is permitted to send as; a rejected sender fails the send.

fields.Name: DigestProvider
fields.Comments: The name of the communication provider that sends the digest, exactly as it appears in MJ: Communication Providers (for example the Microsoft Graph or SendGrid provider this host has configured). Blank means a real run stops up front with one error naming this setting. A dry run does not need it.
